data.title: horse/: generate page from BRANDING.md — frames from Smithsonian scan, config mapping, build

data.body: Follow-up to FA-17 (horse/BRANDING.md, done). Scope: (1) cut the 12 panels out of the user-supplied Smithsonian/LOC scan with ffmpeg (user-specified tool; brew install running) and assemble the horse/frames.jpg sprite strip per BRANDING.md; (2) generate horse/index.html+style.css+script.js from BRANDING.md via the brand-page skill; (3) map mobile landscape slot to horse in sites.config.json; (4) node build.js; commit all. Source facts: S3 original at https://tf-cmsv2-smithsonianmag-media.s3.amazonaws.com/filer/b7/1e/b71e206b-df4a-4d9e-958a-1a249c544c6e/the_horse_in_motion_2_resized.jpg is 1536x1200 JPEG, LOC scan of the 1878 card: 4x3 grid of 12 numbered panels (frame 12 = standing horse), caption band below. ~340px per panel — below BRANDING.md's 800px/frame ideal; accepted, user chose this source. Downloaded copy: scratchpad horse_fullres.jpg.

REVIEW (agent:claude-fable-5-reviewer, commit 459b7ac + fix 697c9bf): PASS with one inline fix. Verified against plan acceptance criteria and the authoring contract: frames.jpg is 4224x224 = 12 uniform 352x224 frames cut with ffmpeg, printed order 1-12 confirmed visually (f12 = standing horse with printed numeral), rail registered, no border bleed, 129KB JPEG. Per-frame width 352px < the 800px BRANDING ideal — waived per user's source choice, no upscaling (noted per plan). All ids horse- prefixed (f01-f12 + horse-grain filter in data-URI); @import at top with %3B encoding; comment-stripping in build.js makes the leading comment safe; no commas in functional pseudos; absolute /horse/frames.jpg; sprite math correct (background-size 1200%, offset (i-1)/11*100%); wrap-around anchors f01<->f12 correct; playback layer after the 12 slides so .frame:first-of-type default holds; caption band with identity links + Muybridge credit + TAP-SWIPE below the stage; no scroll container, no display on html/body. JS: single registry function, root.querySelector only, listeners on stage only, no window/document handlers, no location reads, node --check clean. sites.config.json: only mobile.landscape changed to horse. node build.js idempotent against the commit; built page gates #site-horse behind (hover:none)(pointer:coarse)(orientation:landscape); standalone /horse/ serves 200. ONE BUG FOUND AND FIXED INLINE (697c9bf): commit()'s synthetic anchor click was suppressed by the stage's own tap-suppressor (moved flag still true on the slow-release / reduced-motion / pointercancel path), so a slow scrub never updated the hash and snapped back to the pre-scrub frame; fixed by resetting moved before the commit click. Momentum path was unaffected (native click resets the flag before the async rAF commit). Meets acceptance criteria; moving to done.
